description: The donut chart, titled “Task Type” and aggregated over both agencies, visually represents the proportional distribution of three distinct journalistic tasks performed using generative AI. The largest segment, colored in reddish-pink, corresponds to “Article generation,” which accounts for 83.1% of the total tasks. The second-largest segment, in yellow, represents “Headline generation” at 12.8%. The smallest segment, in light blue, indicates “Article editing,” comprising just 4.1% of the tasks. Each segment is clearly labeled with its task name and percentage, positioned adjacent to the corresponding slice, and the chart’s central white space contains the bolded title “Task Type.” The visual hierarchy emphasizes the dominance of article generation, with the remaining tasks occupying significantly smaller proportions.
